items.html: Afterward, when the Emanator wished to correct them, He also raised the vessels in Atzilut in the order of three lines. After they became lines, the first Ibur of ZON came, and a second correction was added, where the lights entered within the vessels. However, it was still only in the phase of three lines alone, which we call “three included in three.” Afterward they expanded in the secret of VAK during the time of Yenika. And afterward, during the time of Mochin, all ten vessels were completed. There was yet another change: at first, before there was any Ibur — even the first Ibur of ZON — there was only a restricted light in the vessel, and afterward the vessel grew and expanded in the secret of a complete Partzuf, in order to diminish the light, for this is the main intent of the correction.
